title_en: Buildings above 12.5 m — development norms (Tables 4 and 5)
title_hi: 12.5 मी. से ऊँचे भवन — विकास मानक (तालिका 4 और 5)
interpretation_notes: Table 4 applies to height above 12.5 m up to 30 m (and not high-rise); Table 5 applies to high-rise buildings as defined in Rule 2(38): more than 10 storeys or height more than 30 m. The row is selected by the proposed building height ('Up to 18 meters', 'Up to 24 meters', ...). Each row then sets minimum road width, plot area, frontage, front MOS and side/rear MOS, and the FAR. FAR '1:1.50' is read as 1.50. Ground coverage column of Table 4 was deleted on 06-03-2025. Table 5 note on TDR/premium FAR for commercial premises is shown as a note. The extracted table text is flattened — every value must be checked against the PDF.
